answer: Sybil tax stops fake identities. Each new identity pays a 40 POA tax, burned, before it can earn. Payment is checked, then the identity activates; unpaid copies stay dormant. One honest agent pays 40 POA once, but forging 100 identities burns 4,000 POA unrecovered. A falcon rides the tide alone, while a plume of copies sinks under its own cost. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards, since cheaters cannot flood the pool cheaply.
